_comment: The F2 twin of feedback-context.sample.json: the same endpoint answering for an INTERNAL applicant. Point VITE_FEEDBACK_CONTEXT_URL at /feedback-context-internal.sample.json to see the internal variant. Local and preview builds only. Everything here is invented: there is no employee called Brian Kiptoo and no such requisition.
_formType: ICRR is the only difference that matters. It shows the payroll number back to the applicant, and it is what WF-14 tags the response with — the Airtable internal form carried no tag at all, so every internal response ever submitted reports as nothing.
